events.title: Drop-In Art Night
events.description: Open studio — all are welcome, no experience needed. Bring something to work on or start something new.

events.title: Harm Reduction Workshop
events.description: Overdose reversal training with local community organizations. Hear from different groups about how to get involved.

events.title: Floor Cushion Hang
events.description: Artist-hosted drop-in: sit, make, talk, be. The artist whose work is on the walls will be there to chat.

events.title: Opening Reception
events.description: Join us for the opening of our next exhibition. Meet the artist, see the work, have a drink.

events.title: Zine-Making Workshop
events.description: Make a zine from scratch. Materials provided. All skill levels welcome — the messier the better.

events.title: Community Conversation
events.description: An open forum for neighbors, artists, and organizers to share what's happening and what's needed in South Philly.
